units.source_text: 我覺得以往的自己是那麼的天真可愛，甚至有點想笑，我也因此開始一點一點地瞭解世人的真面目了。

en.t: I felt that my former self had been so innocent and endearing that I almost wanted to laugh, and little by little I began to understand the true face of the world.

units.source_text: 雖然這麼說，人對於我仍是可怕的存在，跟店裡的顧客見面，必須得先喝下一杯酒才行，因為我要見可怕的人。

en.t: Even so, people were still frightening beings to me, and before meeting customers at the shop I had to drink a glass of liquor, because I was about to face frightening people.

units.source_text: 我每晚都會出現在店裡，就像小時候把害怕的小動物用力緊攥在手中一樣，

en.t: Every night I would show up at the shop, like a child clutching a small animal tightly in his hand because he was afraid of it,

units.source_text: 藉著酒勁，向客人吹噓拙劣的藝術論。

en.t: using the force of drink to boast to the customers about my clumsy theories of art.

units.source_text: 啊，我只是一個沒有大喜大悲無名的漫畫家。

en.t: Ah, I was only an unknown manga artist, without any great joy or great sorrow.
